description: Bounded exact Connect Four endgame solver from the Fhourstones 2.0/3.1 solver family.

pinned_source.distribution_notice: John Tromp (1996; 1996-2005): notice must not be removed; no sale for profit; redistribution only if recipients have the same rights and restrictions.

pinned_launchers.run_options: reads 1-based columns 1 through 7, one position per input line
reads 1-based columns 1 through 7, one position per input line; dataset selected by SMALL_PROBLEM_SIZE

contract.board: Seven columns by six rows; pieces fall to the lowest empty row; players alternate starting with player 1.
contract.bounded_position: 36 through 41 legal moves, leaving at most six empty cells.
contract.history: Every column is 0 through 6; no column is overfilled; no prior move in the history has made four in a row.
contract.algorithm: Exact alpha-beta negamax to terminal win or full board, center-first move order; the portable bounded implementation omits the pinned solver's transposition table and history heuristic.
contract.result: 2 for a forced win, 0 for a draw, and -2 for a forced loss, from the side-to-move perspective.

output.meaning: Exact game outcome for the current player; uses Fhourstones 2.0's -2/0/2 score values.
